title: Interpretable deep learning maps tissue morphology to survival in liver and lung cancer
summary: MorphX gave C-index 0.775-0.799 in discovery and yielded eight morphology biomarkers with survival associations in independent cohorts among 1067 HCC and LUAD patients. The study is retrospective and shows prognostic association only.
ai_technology: MorphX, an interpretable deep learning framework on whole-slide images

evidence.unknown: Retrospective; prognostic association only; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: MorphX interpretable deep learning on whole-slide images yields morphology biomarkers
